objective_summary.value: Use gas-fed porous burners to emulate burning of solid and liquid materials in still (quiescent) microgravity air, including the atmospheres NASA considers for crewed exploration.

prov.quote: NASA - considered atmosphere for human space missions will be examined: 14.7 psia, 21 % oxygen: 10.2 psia, 26.5 %; and 8.2 psia, 34 % oxygen.

approach_summary.value: Ethylene or methane (diluted with N2) flowed through 25 or 50 mm porous burners in chambers set to chosen O2 and pressure; flames observed until extinction or steady state to build a flammability map.

prov.quote: The ongoing combustion without air flow was notably seen in elevated-oxygen atmospheres which are being considered for use in future spacecraft, whereas such flames in a normal atmosphere of 21% oxygen self-extinguished in a short time.
